        "sql": "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) -- Q3: contribution funnel fork -> open PR -> PR merged, per seed repo, and hours from PR\n-- opened to its first merge (p50/p90, linear interpolation = quantile_cont).\n--   forkers             distinct human actors with a ForkEvent on the repo.\n--   forkers_with_pr     forkers who opened a PR on the repo at or after their first fork.\n--   forkers_with_merge  forkers whose such PR was merged.\n--   prs_opened          PRs (repo, number) whose 'opened' event is in the data, author human.\n--                       The author is the actor of the earliest 'opened' event.\n--   prs_merged          of those, PRs with a merge event at or after opening. A merge event is\n--                       action 'merged' (GH Archive since 2025) or action 'closed' with\n--                       payload.pull_request.merged = true (older payloads).\n-- Repos appear when they have >= 1 fork or >= 1 human PR opened. Definitions of seed repo and\n-- bot: see q1.sql.\nWITH ev AS (\n    SELECT\n        e.actor.login AS actor_login,\n        ends_with(lower(e.actor.login), '[bot]') OR ends_with(lower(e.actor.login), '-bot') AS is_bot,\n        r.repo_name,\n        e.type,\n        e.payload ->> '$.action' AS action,\n        e.payload ->> '$.pull_request.merged' AS merged_flag,\n        TRY_CAST(coalesce(e.payload ->> '$.pull_request.number', e.payload ->> '$.number') AS BIGINT)\n            AS pr_number,\n        e.created_at\n    FROM raw_events AS e\n    JOIN repos AS r ON lower(e.repo.name) = lower(r.repo_name)\n    WHERE e.type IN ('ForkEvent', 'PullRequestEvent')\n),\nforks AS (\n    SELECT repo_name, actor_login, min(created_at) AS forked_at\n    FROM ev\n    WHERE type = 'ForkEvent' AND NOT is_bot\n    GROUP BY repo_name, actor_login\n),\nopened AS (\n    SELECT\n        repo_name,\n        pr_number,\n        arg_min(actor_login, created_at) AS author,\n        arg_min(is_bot, created_at) AS author_is_bot,\n        min(created_at) AS opened_at\n    FROM ev\n    WHERE type = 'PullRequestEvent' AND action = 'opened' AND pr_number IS NOT NULL\n    GROUP BY repo_name, pr_number\n),\nmerges AS (\n    SELECT repo_name, pr_number, created_at AS merged_at\n    FROM ev\n    WHERE type = 'PullRequestEvent'\n        AND (action = 'merged' OR (action = 'closed' AND merged_flag = 'true'))\n),\nprs AS (\n    SELECT o.repo_name, o.pr_number, o.author, o.opened_at, min(m.merged_at) AS merged_at\n    FROM opened AS o\n    LEFT JOIN merges AS m\n        ON m.repo_name = o.repo_name AND m.pr_number = o.pr_number AND m.merged_at >= o.opened_at\n    WHERE NOT o.author_is_bot\n    GROUP BY o.repo_name, o.pr_number, o.author, o.opened_at\n),\nfunnel AS (\n    SELECT\n        f.repo_name,\n        count(DISTINCT f.actor_login) AS forkers,\n        count(DISTINCT f.actor_login) FILTER (WHERE p.pr_number IS NOT NULL) AS forkers_with_pr,\n        count(DISTINCT f.actor_login) FILTER (WHERE p.merged_at IS NOT NULL) AS forkers_with_merge\n    FROM forks AS f\n    LEFT JOIN prs AS p\n        ON p.repo_name = f.repo_name AND p.author = f.actor_login AND p.opened_at >= f.forked_at\n    GROUP BY f.repo_name\n),\npr_stats AS (\n    SELECT\n        repo_name,\n        count(*) AS prs_opened,\n        count(merged_at) AS prs_merged,\n        quantile_cont((epoch(merged_at) - epoch(opened_at)) / 3600, 0.5) AS p50,\n        quantile_cont((epoch(merged_at) - epoch(opened_at)) / 3600, 0.9) AS p90\n    FROM prs\n    GROUP BY repo_name\n)\nSELECT\n    r.repo_name,\n    r.category,\n    coalesce(f.forkers, 0) AS forkers,\n    coalesce(f.forkers_with_pr, 0) AS forkers_with_pr,\n    coalesce(f.forkers_with_merge, 0) AS forkers_with_merge,\n    coalesce(s.prs_opened, 0) AS prs_opened,\n    coalesce(s.prs_merged, 0) AS prs_merged,\n    round(s.p50, 2) AS merge_hours_p50,\n    round(s.p90, 2) AS merge_hours_p90\nFROM repos AS r\nLEFT JOIN funnel AS f ON f.repo_name = r.repo_name\nLEFT JOIN pr_stats AS s ON s.repo_name = r.repo_name\nWHERE f.repo_name IS NOT NULL OR s.repo_name IS NOT NULL\nORDER BY r.repo_name\n",
